title: From Learning to Control: Data-Driven Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Multivariable Control in a Microalgae Bioprocess
summary: Effective control of bioprocesses is particularly challenging due to the intrinsic nonlinearity and dynamic variability of living-cell systems. In microalgae-based photobioreactors (PBRs), maintaining stable pH and dissolved oxygen (DO) levels is critical for optimal growth and productivity, yet their strong coupling and sensitivity to environmental fluctuations make multivariable control difficult. This study proposes a novel hybrid offline-online Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) framework for simultaneous pH and DO regulation, leveraging Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) agents to achieve a fully data-driven and model-free control solution. The agents are trained using historical data generated by an expert system, eliminating the need for direct experimentation with the environment. After deployment, the agents operate autonomously, continuously fine-tuning their policies daily to adapt to evolving process dynamics and reject fast transient disturbances. Experimental validation in an open, industrial-scale PBR at the University of Almeria demonstrated the framework's capability to maintain stable operation under realistic conditions. The results confirm that model-free MARL control provides a robust and adaptive alternative for complex bioprocess environments.

AI.tldr: 提出基于离线-在线 MARL 和 DDPG 的无模型控制框架，实现微藻 PBR pH 与 DO 同时稳定调节。
AI.translated_summary: 由于活体细胞系统固有的非线性和动态可变性，生物过程的有效控制尤其具有挑战性。在基于微藻的光生物反应器（PBR）中，维持稳定的 pH 和溶解氧（DO）水平对于最佳生长和生产力至关重要，但由于它们与环境波动的强耦合和敏感性，多变量控制变得困难。本研究提出了一种新颖的混合离线-在线多智能体强化学习（MARL）框架，用于同时调节 pH 和 DO，利用深度确定性策略梯度（DDPG）智能体实现完全数据驱动、无模型的控制解决方案。这些智能体使用专家系统生成的历史数据进行训练，消除了直接与环境实验的需求。部署后，智能体自主运行，持续每日微调其策略以适应不断演变的工艺动态并抑制快速瞬态干扰。在西班牙阿尔梅里亚大学一个开放、工业规模的 PBR 中进行的实验验证，证明了该框架在现实条件下维持稳定运行的能力。结果证实，无模型 MARL 控制为复杂的生物过程环境提供了一种稳健且自适应的替代方案。

title: Learning Metamaterial Eigenmodes with Wavelet-Encoded Fourier Neural Operators
summary: Machine learning surrogates based on neural operators have shown broad applicability in solving forward PDE problems. However, eigenvalue problems, in which an eigenparameter and one of several valid eigenmodes must be simultaneously solved, remain difficult because standard operator learning formulations assume a unique input-output map. This work demonstrates that Fourier Neural Operators (FNOs), combined with wavelet-based encodings of PDE inputs, can learn and predict multiple eigenmodes of the elastic wave equation, corresponding to deformation modes of acoustic waves propagating through arbitrary metamaterial geometries. We provide a mechanistic explanation and experimental evidence for why wavelet encodings are well matched to the dual spatial-spectral structure of the FNO, enabling deterministic mode selection on both continuous-valued and binary-valued geometries within a single model, and for why prediction accuracy varies with geometric discontinuities. For metamaterial design, the resulting surrogate accelerates the simulation stage of the design cycle by three orders of magnitude relative to finite element analysis on a consumer-grade CPU, while preserving high fidelity. These results also carry broader implications for designing input encodings in other multi-mode PDE solvers based on spectral neural operators.

AI.tldr: FNO结合小波编码可预测弹性波动方程多特征模态并加速超材料设计仿真
AI.translated_summary: 基于神经算子的机器学习代理在求解前向偏微分方程方面显示出广泛适用性。然而，特征值问题（需要同时求解特征参数和多个有效特征模态）仍然困难，因为标准算子学习公式假设唯一的输入-输出映射。本文展示了Fourier Neural Operators (FNOs)与基于小波的PDE输入编码相结合，可以学习并预测弹性波动方程的多个特征模态，对应于通过任意超材料几何体传播的声波变形模态。我们提供了小波编码与FNO的双空间-谱结构相匹配的机理解释和实验证据，使得在单个模型内对连续值和二进制值几何体进行确定性模态选择成为可能，并解释了预测精度为何随几何不连续性而变化。对于超材料设计，由此产生的代理模型相比消费者级CPU上的有限元分析，将设计循环的仿真阶段加速了三个数量级，同时保持了高保真度。这些结果对设计其他基于谱神经算子的多模态PDE求解器中的输入编码也具有更广泛的意义。
AI.research_problem: 标准算子学习假设唯一的输入-输出映射，难以同时求解特征值问题中的特征参数和多个有效特征模态。
AI.key_innovation: 将Fourier Neural Operators (FNOs)与基于小波的PDE输入编码相结合，利用小波编码与FNO双空间-谱结构的匹配特性，实现单个模型内对连续值和二进制值几何体的确定性多特征模态选择。
AI.motivation: 弹性波动方程的特征值问题对于超材料设计等应用至关重要，但现有算子学习方法难以同时求解特征参数和多个特征模态，限制了其在多模态PDE求解中的应用。
AI.method: 采用Fourier Neural Operators (FNOs)结合基于小波的PDE输入编码，利用小波编码与FNO双空间-谱结构的匹配特性，在单个模型内实现多特征模态的预测。
AI.experiments: 在任意超材料几何体上预测弹性波动方程的声波传播变形模态，包括连续值和二进制值几何体；与有限元分析进行对比评估。
AI.result: 相比消费者级CPU上的有限元分析，加速仿真阶段三个数量级，同时保持高保真度；证明小波编码与FNO结构匹配，可实现确定性模态选择。
AI.conclusion: FNO结合小波编码能够有效预测弹性波动方程多特征模态，显著加速超材料设计仿真，为基于谱神经算子的多模态PDE求解器提供了输入编码设计的启示。
